counts.basis: Each executed tools.exec_command counts once, including individually awaited and Promise.allSettled calls. All input strings and downstream pipeline stages were inspected without executing participant inputs.
counts.discovery_definition: Initial source-file inventory; focused content reads/searches count as source.

byte_evidence.methodology: All returned command bodies decode completely and map one-to-one to executed calls; no outer truncation or unattributable emission. Sum UTF-8 output payload bytes excluding wrappers and JSON serialization.
byte_evidence.limits: Exact captured attributable source payload bytes only, not total model-delivered context. Runtime counters are a separate boundary; no byte estimator is used as observed tokens.

hook_metrics.boundary: Installed hook execution is not separately observed. Scoped retrieval server handler elapsed is in bridge_metrics; controller observe export is separate. Server token fields are byte estimates, not runtime token usage.

tool_failure_evidence: All 26 decoded command results have exit_code zero.

scope_evidence.all_workdirs: Bootstrap omits workdir but reads only the allowed absolute RTK.md path; all source calls explicitly use /tmp/aide-outcomes-v5-trials/t09/root
scope_evidence.source_access: All reads, searches and inventories stay in the fixture. Scoped bridge uses only supplied arguments; bridge implementation, binary, evidence and controller .aide state are not read by participant. No edits, test execution, native/global aide, direct aide CLI, outside-source/grader/reference/runtime-log reads, web, subagents, commits or reindex observed.
scope_evidence.controller_state: No participant .aide traversal or mutation observed. Broad source inventories/searches exclude .aide.
scope_evidence.boundary: Observed tool inputs and independently checked source evidence; encrypted delivered task plaintext remains unknown.

launcher_evidence.actual_launcher_text_comparison: Host NEW_TASK payload is encrypted_content; controller archive, prepared prompt, prelaunch, launch and regenerated frozen prompt match exactly, but delivered plaintext equality is unknown.

bridge_evidence.source_snapshot_basis: Every call source inventory independently matches all 50 frozen source files and unchanged final candidate. Every retrieval receipt hash and full-file byte count checked against matching full snapshots.

limitations: Bridge process timings include orchestration; request roundtrip is not handler compute or CPU time.
Setup indexing and controller observe export costs are separate from participant bridge calls.
Emitted bytes follow the bridge's successful return path; host delivery/truncation and omitted attempts require trace review.
Setup stores a binary digest; call records bind to setup but do not contain an independently repeated binary digest.
Source receipt SHA256 is checked against pre-call inventory. Full-file bytes are independently verified only for supplied snapshots matching that exact hash; other versions remain unknown.
Static seed search/references can be stale after edits; source_changed_since_seed is recorded without assuming result freshness.
